products.name: Member Change Cutoff
products.product: A focused CSA skip swap and pickup change tracking workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: small community-supported agriculture farms and farm-box programs
products.problem: Skips, pickup moves, box swaps, donations, vacation holds, and address changes arrive around harvest and packing cutoffs through several member channels.
products.valueProposition: Turns CSA skip swap and pickup change tracking into a visible operating queue so every eligible member change is applied before the correct packing and route cutoff or closed with a clear alternative.
